description: A custom Android View class named InternalSelectionView that manages a selectable list of rows, handles focus and key events, and visually indicates the selected row.

classes.name: InternalSelectionView
classes.description: A custom View that displays multiple selectable rows, manages internal selection state, and handles focus and key events.

methods.name: InternalSelectionView
methods.description: Constructs the view with context, number of rows, and optional label.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the view's dimensions based on measure specs.

methods.name: measureWidth
methods.description: Calculates desired width based on measure spec.

methods.name: measureHeight
methods.description: Calculates desired height based on measure spec.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the rows, highlighting the selected one.

methods.name: getRectForRow
methods.description: Provides rectangle bounds for a specific row.

methods.name: ensureRectVisible
methods.description: Requests to make the selected row visible on screen.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles up/down key events to change selection.

methods.name: getFocusedRect
methods.description: Provides the rectangle of the currently focused row.

methods.name: onFocusChanged
methods.description: Updates selection based on focus change direction.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns label if set, otherwise default string.
